command:
set -euo pipefail; echo SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service); echo XRANDR; DISPLAY=:0 xrandr --query | sed -n '1,12p'; echo XDTOOL_WINDOWS; ids=$(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool search --name '^FranKenstein -- live$' 2>/dev/null || true); printf '%s
' "$ids"; echo COUNT=$(printf '%s
' "$ids" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l); if [ -n "$ids" ]; then w=$(printf '%s
' "$ids" | head -1); echo XDTOOL_GEOMETRY; DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell "$w"; echo WMCTRL; DISPLAY=:0 wmctrl -lxG | grep -F 'FranKenstein -- live' || true; echo WINDOWPID=$(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowpid "$w" || true); fi; pid=$(cat /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/chrome.pid 2>/dev/null || true); echo PIDFILE=$pid; if [ -n "$pid" ] && [ -r /proc/$pid/cmdline ]; then echo CHROME_CMDLINE; tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$pid/cmdline; echo; fi; echo LIVE_SHA=$(sha256sum /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html | awk '{print $1}'); echo MARKERS=$(grep -c 'FRANK_MICROEXPR_V1 BEGIN' /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html); echo MICRO_CALLS=$(grep -c '_mikroMimikSchritt(t);' /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html); echo STATE_HOOKS=$(grep -c '_mikroMimikStateAktualisieren(b);' /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html)
